label: end-of-episode (low value) unit, silenced by S2 / a1 inputs
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode (99.9% of activations at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80), where the value head output is low because few rewards remain. All activation mass is at value < 5.22, and value < 3 is a tighter cut. Inside that window the unit is almost never active on steps whose input shows state S2 (D2 after reaching S2) or last action a1 (D2 after choosing a1), so the predicate excludes those inputs. It leans toward a2 contexts (action==2 holds 88% of the mass, choice logit negative), but adding that condition did not raise F1. Recorded (value < 3) & no S2/a1 input: dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.90. Missed: activations at value 3-4 on earlier end-of-episode steps. False positives: low-value steps in a1-leaning episodes. Top windows peak on the window final steps (the episode last trials), consistent with an end-of-episode/time-remaining signal, but I did not separately check magnitude against value. It uses only observed or self-computed variables: value is the model own output, and the inputs are observed.
